explanations.reason: Renamed, not removed: the owner-approved editor mockup (docs/audit/mockups/editor.html) opens with the explorer (248 px), the Properties panel (288 px) and the Problems panel (148 px) open, so the WP-21 first view with every panel closed and the document at 55% of 1366x768 is replaced by the mockup's (about 34% in the mockup itself; the test now asks 30% and checks that the three panels are open).
